relevant_files.purpose: Parses the QiangZhi (强智) course table HTML: walks #kbtable tr/td grid, extracts per-cell course text via tag-stripping regex, splits week/section tokens from the '(1-16周)[1-2节]' cell line, handles 单周/双周 odd/even filtering, and merges duplicate same-name same-week-different cells; emits courseInfos + hardcoded 12-section sectionTimes.

DOM provider: grabs the timetable HTML from the iframe containing a form with id 'Form1' (classic QiangZhi jwgl frameset), returning Form1.innerHTML to the parser. No network endpoint construction here — endpoint calls are made by the 小爱课程表 host app (standard 强智 xskb_list.do page).

protocol_approach: This is a 小爱课程表 (XiaoAi) import adapter for 强智 (QiangZhi) jwgl systems, implemented as the standard XiaoAi import-script pair (scheduleHtmlProvider + scheduleHtmlParser). It does not build the endpoint URL itself; it scrapes the DOM the host app has already loaded — the timetable page of a 强智 system, which by protocol is the kbtable rendered by xskb_list.do — pulling it out of an iframe via a form with id 'Form1'. Parsing is grid-coordinate based: td column index col maps to day = col+1 (Monday=col0), rows are walked top-down, and section numbers come from parsing the trailing '[start-end节]' token of each cell, expanding start..end into a sections list. Week tokens 'X-Y周' / comma lists are expanded with 单/双 filters: a cell line containing 单 keeps odd weeks, 双 keeps even weeks, matching Sleepy's semantics exactly.
verdict_reason: Independent student-maintained JavaScript implementation of the same 强智 protocol family: it parses the 强智 kbtable grid (#kbtable), extracts week/section coordinate tokens from the cell's '(N-N周)[N-N节]' text, applies 单周=odd / 双周=even week filtering, and obtains the HTML from the classic 强智 Form1 iframe — all matching Sleepy's claimed QiangZhi xskb_list.do + .kbcontent parsing family semantics (HTML source differs only in selector name; the .kbcontent cell is the same kbtable's cell class this repo consumes via td traversal).

sleepy_claim_check.强智 xskb_list.do + .kbcontent 解析形态: match — same 强智 protocol family: this repo consumes the same kbtable HTML (Form1 iframe of the xskb_list.do-rendered page; no explicit URL because XiaoAi host app navigates), parses cells by tr/td traversal rather than the .kbcontent class selector, and applies identical 单周=odd/双周=even week and [start-end节] section semantics. Endpoint itself not constructed in-repo (host-app navigation), so xskb_list.do is confirmed indirectly via the Form1 iframe DOM shape.
